title: Format an invoice
description: Each item has a name, a quantity and a unit price in cents. Produce one text: for every item in order a line "NAME xQTY @ UNIT = AMOUNT", then "TOTAL SUM", all joined with "; ". Money is written as dollars, a dot and exactly two cent digits (205 is "2.05", 7 is "0.07", 0 is "0.00"); AMOUNT is quantity times unit price and SUM is the sum of all amounts. An empty list gives just "TOTAL 0.00". If an item has quantity below 1 or a negative unit price, return an error "invalid item: NAME" for the first such item in order instead.
notes: Zero-padding of the cents (05, 07, 00) is the main trap. Amounts and sums stay far below 2^53. All divisions and remainders are on non-negative numbers.
